A single continuous cinematic 20-second LTX-2.3 dual-character dialogue image-to-video shot based on the provided first frame, preserving stable character identity, stable left-right positioning, and smooth magical storytelling continuity.

The scene takes place on a quiet rooftop observatory at night under a deep purple-blue starry sky, with a crescent moon, floating golden constellation cards, a telescope in the background, stone walls, soft starlight, and warm magical glow.

On the left, a gentle blue-haired anime astrologer girl in a white-gold celestial robe holds an open star book, smiling brightly and raising one finger as if explaining a spell.

On the right, a cute small stone golem with glowing green eyes and green rune marks sits on the stone ledge, holding a small glowing crystal, looking up at the girl with innocent curiosity.

Keep the astrologer girl always on the left and the stone golem always on the right. Keep both characters facing each other, maintaining eye contact, soft expressions, subtle hand gestures, slight hair movement, floating card motion, green rune glow, and a warm magical night atmosphere.

The tone is funny, cute, whimsical, and slightly magical, like a young astrologer trying to teach a tiny stone golem how to make a wish on the stars. Clear Mandarin Chinese dialogue with natural lip sync, no subtitles, no text on screen.

[0-4s] The camera holds a medium two-shot. The astrologer girl smiles gently, lifts one finger, and points toward the bright star beside the crescent moon. She says in Mandarin Chinese: “看见月边那颗最亮的星了吗？听说对着它许愿，心事就会轻一点。”

|

[4-8s] The stone golem looks up at the sky, carefully raises the glowing crystal in its small hand, and replies in Mandarin Chinese with a cute deep rocky voice: “那我正好要许这个愿。我要是能轻一点，以后跳舞就不会把地板踩裂了。”

|

[8-12s] The girl blinks, then lowers her book slightly and laughs softly. The floating constellation cards rotate gently around her as she says in Mandarin Chinese: “这个愿望倒是很实在。星星未必会直接帮你变轻，不过它们应该会喜欢你的认真。”

|

[12-16s] The golem proudly pats the glowing green rune on its chest. The rune flickers a little brighter, and it says in Mandarin Chinese: “那我还想再许一个愿望。要是一顶会发光的小帽子，跳舞的时候我一定会更像主角。”

|

[16-20s] The girl smiles, raises one finger again, and draws a tiny glowing star in the air. The star slowly floats above the golem’s head like a little hat. She says in Mandarin Chinese: “这个愿望，比刚才那个容易实现。” The golem looks up in surprise and delight, and both of them smile as the rooftop glows softly.
